verdict.rationale: Convex ships an official CLI with scriptable commands: `npx convex run` with JSON args, import, export, logs and insights. It also exposes public HTTP endpoints for calling functions and can be self-hosted via Docker or a binary, so programmatic, non-UI operation is documented. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents CI usage, such as deploy keys, non-interactive auth or a deploy-in-CI workflow, and the documented `run` target is the dev deployment. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless deploy documentation (e.g. deploy command, deploy keys/non-interactive auth), production-targeted automation, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: npx convex run <functionName> [args] — Run a public or internal Convex query, mutation, or action on your development deployment.
npx convex export — Export data from your deployment to a ZIP file
These HTTP endpoints allow you to call Convex functions and get the result as a value.
You can either use Docker (recommended) or a prebuilt binary to self host Convex.
